adversarial_pass.summary: A search for reports of throughput collapsing below 10k rps on one node found none.

evidence.summary: Raw benchmark logs the vendor published: 10.4k rps.
A blog post reproduces 10.1k rps on similar hardware.

preregistered_disconfirmers: A reproduction on similar hardware below 8k rps.
A published run where the limiter drops requests below 10k rps at one node.
claims.text: Sustains 10,000 requests per second on one node.

evidence.summary: Vendor design document describes quorum writes.
Vendor marketing page says counters never drift.

claims.text: Counters stay correct when a node fails.

evidence.summary: A forum thread reports a flat graph after seven days.
A newsletter repeats the forum claim.

claims.text: Memory use stays flat over a week.

evidence.summary: An issue-tracker report shows a forced restart on a minor upgrade.
The licence text restricts embedding in a paid product.
A licence survey classes it as source-available, not open.

thesis: The ledgerd rate limiter is ready to replace our in-house one.
